resources.string: Follows the system by default. Dark: black window with white text. Light: white window with black text. Only changes the app display, not system settings or server configuration.
Could not save appearance. Please retry.
Could not submit the server command. Please retry.
Information collection timed out. Recheck to retry.
Could not read server settings. Reopen the app.
No usable network. Check mobile data or Wi-Fi and retry.
Network check timed out. Check the phone network and retry.
None of the four official websites is confirmed reachable over IPv4 HTTPS; only the test sites may be unreachable. Retry later.
Another VPN is the default network. Disconnect it, restore mobile data or Wi-Fi, and recheck.
Reading basic device information (Root will not be requested automatically)…
Request existing Root access and run read-only checks

Verifies uid=0 and reads XFRM, UDP 500/4500 usage, forwarding and SELinux status. Does not change routes, firewall, system files or SELinux, or stop WireGuard. Your Root manager may prompt for each check. This check does not start IKEv2; use the IKEv2 management page to start the service.
The address clients use to reach this server. Enter a hostname or public IPv6 address without brackets. Leave empty to use the configured DDNS hostname or current public IPv6.
Endpoint hostname or public IPv6 (optional; no brackets)
Port range: 1–65535. New installations default to the usual WireGuard port 51820; existing ports are preserved. After changing it, update your clients and router UDP rules.
Tunnel packet size in bytes. Range: 1280–1420; default: 1380. Keep the default if unsure.
Custom DNS IP addresses, separated by commas
Enter the full hostname configured with the selected provider, without https://, a path or a port.
Enter your registered DuckDNS hostname, without https://, a path or a port; DuckDNS also accepts just the subdomain.
Enter your No-IP account / contact email, or DDNS Key username. The password must match that account or Key.
Enter the Dynu username that manages this hostname.
Enter the Token provided by DuckDNS. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; enter a new value when switching providers.
Enter a Cloudflare API Token with DNS edit permission for this zone, not a Global API Key. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; enter a new value when switching providers.

Enter the No-IP password matching the account above, or the Key password matching the DDNS Key username. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; enter a new value when switching providers.
Enter the password used for Dynu dynamic updates. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; enter a new value when switching providers.

Enter only the update Key for the FreeDNS record, not the full update URL or your account password. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; enter a new value when switching providers.
Enter only if the custom URL uses {token}. For the same provider, leave blank to keep the saved value; switching providers never reuses the old Token.
Enter the Zone ID for the Cloudflare zone containing this hostname; it is not the hostname itself.
Enter the ID of the existing AAAA record to update. The app updates existing records only and does not create them; the record uses DNS-only mode.

The app calls this update endpoint using HTTPS GET. The URL must contain {ipv6}; {hostname} and {token} are optional. The app replaces them with the current IPv6, hostname above and Token. Only use an endpoint you trust.
After export, you can seal a peer to remove its exportable private key from this phone. Existing devices can still connect.

No handshake received: connect on the client, check both ports and the endpoint, and confirm the client has IPv6. If it still fails, check inbound UDP on your router / mobile network. There is not enough evidence to identify the cause yet.
Names must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
Peer added. Export its configuration now.
First export the configuration in this session and complete at least one handshake using it.

Sealing deletes the client private key stored on this phone and prevents future exports. Devices that already imported the configuration can still connect. Flash storage deletion is not a verified physical erase.
The server will remove this peer immediately. Previously exported files will not be deleted remotely, but they will no longer allow connections.
An export is already waiting for a destination
Standard WireGuard configuration exported. Connect once before sealing.
Choose the app’s display language. Saved connection settings stay unchanged and WireGuard is not restarted. You may need to re-enter unsaved fields.
Could not save the language selection. Please try again.
No executable su found (it may be hidden)
Check failed; this does not prove Root is unavailable
Could not read (tool, permission or kernel limitations are possible)
Port check failed; usage is unknown
No UDP 500 / 4500 usage observed in this /proc snapshot; binding has not been tested
Requires existing Root authorization and a compatible IPsec kernel; WireGuard is unaffected
Root authorization denied; you can request it again. WireGuard is unaffected
The device kernel does not support the required IPsec features
XFRM read-only checks did not pass; permission, tool or kernel limitations may be responsible
Capability snapshot obtained; the actual IPsec data plane remains unverified. Start and verify it in IKEv2 management.
UDP 500 / 4500 usage observed; IKEv2 has not been started
Root or device check failed; retry manually
Not checked yet; runs automatically when the information page opens
Checking the phone’s Internet connection (IPv4 HTTPS; any one of four websites passes / separate DNS check)…
Phone Internet check passed. Check the client’s own results for client Internet access.
Phone Internet check passed; built-in DNS is off. Clients need a working DNS configuration.
Phone Internet check passed, but upstream DNS is unconfirmed. Check custom DNS or select Automatic, save and retry.
None of the four official websites is confirmed reachable over IPv4 HTTPS. Check mobile data / Wi-Fi or retry later; only the test sites may be unreachable.
Check timed out. Check the phone’s network and retry. This result does not identify the cause of a client problem.
The phone’s physical network is unavailable. Check mobile data / Wi-Fi and retry; the server does not need to be started for this check.
Android has not validated Internet access. Check the Wi-Fi sign-in page or mobile network and retry.
No usable global IPv6 address on this network. Switch to a network with IPv6.
The server’s default network is another VPN. Restore a direct Wi-Fi or mobile connection first.
Waiting for network information. Check the phone’s connection.
Unknown (read failed; SELinux was not changed)
Global IPv6 address candidate observed; public inbound access and IKEv2 reachability are unverified
Only non-global IPv6 observed; public reachability is unproven
Shows AtticusVPN Server status and network recovery
Waiting for a usable public IPv6 network
Clients use the server’s built-in DNS (10.77.0.1)
Checking… Look for a Root permission dialog on the phone. WireGuard runs independently and is unaffected.
Device checks did not complete. Retry manually. IKEv2 remains locked; WireGuard is unaffected.

Last check (check again after permission or network changes)

The configuration and QR code contain the client private key. Share only with devices you trust.
Ready. All four export methods use the same configuration.
WireGuard configuration QR code containing the client private key

Defaults preserve the current configuration. These options apply only to this export and do not change Peer address allocation or the server. The server currently forwards IPv4 Internet traffic only; choosing IPv6 addresses or routes does not add IPv6 Internet support. Custom DNS must be reachable through the selected routes.
Leave blank to use the current configuration
Invalid export options. Use numeric IPs for DNS and network addresses with prefixes for AllowedIPs.
This client no longer exists. Its configuration cannot be exported.
No client private key is available, so the complete configuration cannot be exported again.
Cannot generate the configuration. Check the server public key, Endpoint, port and client private key.
This configuration is too long for a QR code. Export the configuration file instead.
Cannot generate the QR code. Try again or save the .conf file.

This QR code contains the client’s WireGuard private key.

After it is saved to the system gallery, enabled photo backup services such as Google Photos, OneDrive or a device vendor’s cloud gallery may sync it. Other apps with photo access may also read it. AtticusVPN cannot control this syncing.

Anyone who obtains this QR code may be able to connect to the server using this client’s identity.

Continue saving?
QR code saved to the system gallery.\nLocation: Pictures/AtticusVPN
Could not save the QR code. Please try again.
Cannot save the QR code: storage permission was not granted.
Not enough device storage to save the QR code.
The configuration export failed or was interrupted. Please try again.
WireGuard configuration copied. It contains the client private key; keep your clipboard secure.
Cannot copy the configuration. Try again or save the .conf file.
Running VPN servers use foreground notifications and CPU wake locks to keep working with the screen off. Granting access does not start a server.

Android will ask you to allow notifications and exclude this app from battery optimization. You choose each result. Continuous service uses more battery; manufacturer startup or unrestricted battery settings may also need manual setup.

In system app details, choose unrestricted battery use and allow automatic startup/background activity if your phone provides these options. Some brands also require locking the app in recent tasks. Android cannot verify all manufacturer switches. Screen locking should not stop the service, but force-stop, reboot, network loss, system termination or lost Root access can interrupt it. This feature does not retry Root or start at boot.
This system page is unavailable. Search system settings for battery optimization or app permissions.
Check finished. The status above reflects actual system access. Unapproved items can be configured later.
Peer revoked. Authorization synchronization failed, so the VPN service was stopped. Check the settings before restarting.

Apple native VPN / IKEv2: in development and currently locked. Standard ports: UDP 500 / 4500, separate from WireGuard. New WireGuard installations default to port 51820; existing ports are preserved.
